craft_notes: Sthāyin: regent-mime. Rows: waft then ape. Read aloud: even flow.

lines: The even breath roving ten heart-tubes wafts saps evenly through all the frame;
there roving the eight airts, it apes as it were the knowers' regents' play.
l4.sanskrit_cite: samāno hārdīṣu daśāsu nāḍīṣu saṃcaran samaste dehe sāmyena rasādīn vāhayati tatra digaṣṭake saṃcaran taddikpaticeṣṭām iva pramātuḥ anukārayati
